name: arete-docs
description: MCP server for Arete documentation. Exposes search_docs and fetch_page tools backed by docs.arete.run content. Use for answering questions about Arete's Rust DSL, SDKs, CLI, and stack-building workflow.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Arete documentation. Returns matching page snippets ranked by relevance.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Fetch a documentation page as raw markdown.

resources.name: arete-platform
resources.description: Official Arete agent skill for onboarding, API keys, registry access, CLI setup, SDK usage, and stack-building workflows.
